Author: Anna, beerpsi
Name: ExtraChatFork
Description:
ExtraChat adds end-to-end encrypted, cross-data-centre, unlimited linkshells
to the game. (Fork of official plugin with features and some fixes)
Changelog:
- Change the ExtraChat server to something I personally host for better stability. Your old ExtraChat channels and keys are backed up at pluginConfigs/ExtraChatFork/1.bak.json and can replace ExtraChat.json to move back to the official plugin.
- Fix all Japanese worlds being grouped into Elemental data center after patch 7.57

Author: beerpsi
Name: FF Logs Uploader
Punchline: An unofficial in-game log uploader client for FF Logs
Description: An alternative to the Archon App for uploading logs to the FF Logs service. Basic features are covered: uploading a log, splitting a log file, live logging.
Changelog: - Give up on being smart with stopwatch
